display.purpose: The PARLOR wordmark on the home lid, uppercase. Once per app.

headline.purpose: Section headings that open a region.

title.purpose: Card and panel headings; shelf game names run one step larger at 1.75rem.

button.purpose: The single uppercase primary action per screen.

shadows.name: raised-sheet
shadows.purpose: A panel that physically overlaps another, like the join sheet over the lid.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, over an espresso scrim rgba(59, 47, 47, 0.5).

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover/touch on pickable surfaces, paired with translateY(-2px).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one uppercase action per screen: JOIN, START GAME.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); background: var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); color: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2A2020; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Deep Clay pill for positive actions on light surfaces, like Start a room.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid #A9532D; background: #A9532D; color: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #8F4526; border-color: #8F4526; } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary pill: Not ready, Add bot, How to play, Leave room.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); background: transparent; color: var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(59, 47, 47, 0.06); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Room Code Tiles
components.description: Signature: the room code as six mustard letter tiles with a copy-link pill.
components.html: KQ7MPD
components.css: .ds-code { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; background: var(--color-terracotta, #C4663A); max-width: 360px; } .ds-code-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; width: 100%; } .ds-code-tiles span { height: 58px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-mustard, #D4A843); border: 2px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); color: var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 30px; } .ds-code-copy { height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); background: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); color: var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-code-copy:hover { background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-code-copy:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labelled paper field with ink outline; the code variant fills with butter.
components.css: .ds-fields { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; max-width: 340px; } .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); } .ds-input { height: 50px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); background: #FFFFFF; color: var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #71625A; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input-code { height: 56px; background: #F3E2B6; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 0.32em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; }

components.description: Outlined seat with initial avatar, name, roles and status chip.

components.css: .ds-players { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 350px; } .ds-player { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px 8px 8px; border: 2px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; color: var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); } .ds-avatar { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-terracotta, #C4663A); color: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 17px; } .ds-avatar-mustard { background: var(--color-mustard, #D4A843); color: var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); } .ds-player-name { flex: 1; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; } .ds-player-name span { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #71625A; } .ds-chip-ready { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #2F5A3E; color: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); } .ds-chip-waiting { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); color: var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); }

components.name: Game Shelf Block
components.description: A color-blocked game 'box spine' with meta chip and two pills.
components.html:
Kings Corner

2–4 · 15–25m

Build descending sequences of alternating colors — be first to empty your hand.
components.css: .ds-box { max-width: 350px; background: #2F5A3E; color: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); border: 2.5px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); border-radius: 18px; padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-box:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(59, 47, 47, 0.12); } .ds-box-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; } .ds-box h3 { margin: 0; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-box-head span { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-box p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 500; } .ds-box-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-box-ghost, .ds-box-solid { flex: 1; height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-box-ghost { border: 2px solid var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); background: transparent; color: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); font-weight: 700; } .ds-box-ghost:hover { background: rgba(253, 246, 236, 0.12); } .ds-box-solid { border: 2px solid var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); background: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); color: #2F5A3E; font-weight: 800; } .ds-box-solid:hover { background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-box-ghost:focus-visible, .ds-box-solid:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Lid Header
components.description: Full-bleed terracotta lid with wordmark and cream Leave room pill.
components.css: .ds-lid { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 18px 20px; background: var(--color-terracotta, #C4663A); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--color-espresso, #3B2F2F); } .ds-lid-mark { font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); text-decoration: none; } .ds-lid-mark:hover { color: #F3E2B6; } .ds-lid-mark:focus-visible, .ds-lid-leave:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-lid-leave { height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); background: transparent; color: var(--color-cream, #FDF6EC); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-lid-leave:hover { background: rgba(253, 246, 236, 0.14); }

narrative.overview:
Parlor should feel like the lid of a well-made board game: printed in flat colors, outlined in ink, with lettering you can read from across the room. Each screen is a box you open. A terracotta lid sits on top and carries the wordmark and the room code. Below it, the contents are laid out on cream: outlined player rows, a felt-green panel for tonight's game, and colored blocks for each game on the shelf. It's warm because the palette is earthy (clay, felt, mustard, espresso ink on cream stock), and it's playful because the type is heavy and the shapes are chunky and round.

Density is low and the targets are large. Parlor is played on phones held at arm's length and on laptops propped on a kitchen table, usually while people are also talking to each other. So everything is generous and every action is a big, obvious pill. Hierarchy comes from weight and color blocks, not from fine grey type or subtle depth. Expression sits in a few signature moves: the lid, the letter-tile room code, the ink outline and the color-blocked game shelf. Everything else stays plain so those moves read clearly.
keyCharacteristics: Terracotta "lid" header on every main screen, outlined at the bottom in ink.
A 2–2.5px espresso outline on every surface that holds content; none on the cream ground.
Pill-shaped buttons; Nunito 900 for anything that names a thing or an action.
The room code is always shown as individual mustard letter tiles.
Flat at rest. Shadows only for things that physically sit on top of the page.
Each game gets a solid color block, rotating through the palette like box spines on a shelf.

rules.name: The Deep Clay Rule
rules.body: Text smaller than 24px (or 19px bold) never sits on Kiln Terracotta. Use Deep Clay for anything text-bearing that needs to read as terracotta.

rules.name: The One Lid Rule
rules.body: Each screen has at most one Kiln Terracotta block, and it sits at the top. Terracotta further down the page is Deep Clay, used on buttons and the shelf.

rules.name: The Ink-Only Text Rule
rules.body: Text is espresso, cream, or Faded Ink. No stone greys (#a8a29e, #c7c2be, #78716c) and no Tailwind slates.

rules.name: The Shout Once Rule
rules.body: Uppercase Nunito 900 is reserved for the wordmark and the single primary action on a screen (JOIN, START GAME). Everything else is sentence case.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase kicker above a heading or value ("ROOM CODE", "PLAYING"). The thing speaks for itself. Add a plain sentence below it if context is needed.

rules.name: The Flat Box Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest unless it overlaps something. No ambient shadows on ordinary cards.

rules.name: The No Block Shadow Rule
rules.body: Outlines are ink, shadows are soft. No zero-blur offset shadows (4px 4px 0). The printed look comes from the outline, not a fake neo-brutalist drop.

rules.name: The Ink Outline Rule
rules.body: If it holds content, it has a full outline in espresso. If it's the ground, it has none. A bar down one side of a box is never the answer: use a full outline, a fill, or a leading icon.

dos: Do outline every content surface in espresso (2–2.5px) and leave the cream ground un-outlined.
Do use Deep Clay (#A9532D) for any terracotta surface carrying text under 24px; Kiln Terracotta is for the lid.
Do show the room code as six mustard letter tiles, everywhere it appears.
Do keep one uppercase Nunito 900 primary pill per screen, with a hint above it when it's disabled.
Do use Faded Ink (#71625A) for all secondary text; it passes 4.5:1 on every light surface in the palette.
Do use an espresso scrim (rgba(59, 47, 47, 0.5)) behind modals.
Do draw icons as inline stroke SVG (2–2.5px stroke, round caps) and give icon-only buttons an aria-label.
donts: Don't use Tailwind-default indigo, slate, red or green anywhere. These are known drift to migrate: @parlor/ui Button (#6366f1 / #e2e8f0 / #ef4444), Toast (#1e293b / #22c55e / #ef4444), the white Modal on a black scrim, and the lobby's indigo Bot badge and Add Bot button (#e0e7ff / #3730a3).
Don't put a bar down one side of a box (currently RulesModal.svelte .combo-item); use a full outline or a fill.
Don't put small uppercase labels above headings or values ("ROOM CODE", "PLAYING").
Don't use stone greys for text (#a8a29e, #c7c2be fail contrast on cream); use Faded Ink.
Don't put cream or white text under 24px on Kiln Terracotta (#C4663A, 3.69:1).
Don't use zero-blur offset shadows, gradients, glass, or emoji as icons.
Don't hide actions behind hover without showing them on (hover: none) devices.
